name: uk-fuel-prices-history
title: UK fuel prices by filling station, daily

sources.title: Fuel Finder (Department for Energy Security and Net Zero)

fields.name: date
fields.description: Day of observation, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: unleaded_avg_ppl
fields.description: Average unleaded (E10) price, pence per litre, one decimal.

fields.name: unleaded_stations
fields.description: Number of stations behind that average.

fields.name: diesel_avg_ppl
fields.description: Average diesel (B7) price, pence per litre, one decimal.

fields.name: diesel_stations
fields.description: Number of stations behind that average.

fields.name: price_changes
fields.description: Station prices, all fuels and all stations, that differ from the day before. Blank on the first day.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Day of observation, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: town
fields.description: Town name as shown on this site.

fields.name: town_slug
fields.description: Identifier of the town, as in /petrol-prices/<town_slug>.

fields.name: nation
fields.description: England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.

fields.name: unleaded_avg_ppl
fields.description: Average unleaded (E10) price in the town, pence per litre.

fields.name: unleaded_min_ppl
fields.description: Lowest unleaded price at a station in the town that day.

fields.name: unleaded_stations
fields.description: Number of stations behind the unleaded figures.

fields.name: diesel_avg_ppl
fields.description: Average diesel (B7) price in the town, pence per litre.

fields.name: diesel_min_ppl
fields.description: Lowest diesel price at a station in the town that day.

fields.name: diesel_stations
fields.description: Number of stations behind the diesel figures.

fields.name: node_id
fields.description: Fuel Finder identifier of the station. Stable, and the key into the history files.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Station name, with consistent capitalisation.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Brand, one spelling per brand. Blank for independents.

fields.name: brand_raw
fields.description: Brand exactly as the retailer reported it.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Address lines as reported, with consistent capitalisation.

fields.name: town
fields.description: Town as shown on this site.

fields.name: postcode
fields.description: Full postcode.

fields.name: postcode_district
fields.description: Outward code, for example BA1.

fields.name: postcode_area
fields.description: Postcode area, for example BA.

fields.name: nation
fields.description: Derived from the postcode, as the feed's own country field is unreliable.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS84 latitude.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS84 longitude.

fields.name: motorway
fields.description: 1 for motorway services.

fields.name: supermarket
fields.description: 1 for a supermarket forecourt.

fields.name: members_only
fields.description: 1 where only members can buy fuel (Costco).

fields.name: services
fields.description: Services reported by the station, separated by semicolons.

fields.name: temporarily_closed
fields.description: 1 if the feed marks the station temporarily closed.

fields.name: first_seen
fields.description: First day we recorded a price for the station.

fields.name: last_seen
fields.description: Last day we recorded a price for the station.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The station's page on this site.

fields.name: fuels
fields.description: Fuel grades the station declares it sells, separated by semicolons (E10, E5, B7_STANDARD, B7_PREMIUM, B10, HVO). A grade missing here proves nothing.

fields.name: opening_hours
fields.description: Opening hours in OpenStreetMap opening_hours syntax, converted from the feed. Blank when any day is not reported.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Public phone number, as reported.

fields.name: coordinates_fix
fields.description: Blank when the position is as reported. swapped: latitude and longitude were inverted; longitude_sign: the sign was lost; both were corrected because only the corrected point falls in the UK. outside_uk: left as reported, and wrong.

fields.name: change
fields.description: arrival (first price reported), departure (no price for 7 days or more) or return (reporting again after such a gap).

fields.name: date
fields.description: Arrival: first day with a price. Departure: last day with a price. Return: day it came back.

fields.name: node_id
fields.description: Fuel Finder identifier, as in stations.csv.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Station name.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Brand, one spelling per brand. Blank for independents.

fields.name: town
fields.description: Town as shown on this site.

fields.name: postcode
fields.description: Full postcode.

fields.name: nation
fields.description: England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.

fields.name: days
fields.description: Departure: days since the last price. Return: length of the absence, in days.

fields.name: permanently_closed_on
fields.description: Departure: the date the feed gives for a permanent closure, when it gives one.

fields.name: temporarily_closed
fields.description: Departure: 1 if the feed marked the station temporarily closed the last time we saw it.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: The station's page on this site, while it is in the feed.

fields.name: node_id
fields.description: Fuel Finder identifier, as in stations.csv.

fields.name: fuel
fields.description: E10, E5, B7_STANDARD, B7_PREMIUM, B10 or HVO.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Day of observation, YYYY-MM-DD. One reading per station, fuel and day: the last one we saw.

fields.name: price_ppl
fields.description: Price in pence per litre.

fields.name: price_last_updated
fields.description: When the retailer last changed this price, as reported by the feed (UTC).
